notes.title: Version 0.2.2 - Journey Saving, Enemy Inertia, Demo Updates
notes.content:
[b]Together with these changes the demo build has been updated to include all of the QoL stuff that we added to the game as well as showcasing some of the features that can be accessed in the full version.[/b]

[h1]Balance/Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now save your run at any point and continue it later
[*] Added enemy Inertia. Enemies now react to the trains movement. They need some time to adjust when speeding up and slowing down. (These changes should not only make enemies feel more natural but also make some of the speedy builds more viable and powerful)
[*] Repair and Shoveling minigames now need to be unlocked in the HUB and have a small tutorial. They can also be toggled on and off
[*] Using the shoveling minigame now speeds up the overfilling process
[*] Magazine UI is now smoothly animated
[*] Added various new sounds
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] EMP particles now cover the whole screen
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller prompt in the dialogue boxes was wrong
[*] Lots of fixes related to reloading, where reloads could get stuck forever, bullets getting lots, animations getting stuck.
[*] Fixed issue where event locations could give no rewards, or break the entire reward screen
[*] Fixed issue where coal could be filled infinitely with minigame
[*] Fixed issue where modules could become uninteractable
[*] Fixed don't spawn in the HUB
[*] Fixed issue that caused camera shake to be disabled
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.1 - Repair & Shovel Minigame / Reloading Rework / Coop Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Hey! Version 0.2.1 Is now Live![/h1]
[h2]
Balance/Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Repairing and Shoveling Minigames - Express your skill by completing a simple minigame that lets you increase the speed at which you repair and shovel
[*] Small Reloading Rework - Now instead of always dropping the whole clip, the clip gets filled from the place you left it, but there is always a set reload time that needs to happen first
[*] Increased difficulty when playing in coop - Enemies are tougher and repairing and shoveling is slowed down (this is just a first pass on these, we will continue expanding and imroving coop difficulty in the future)
[*] Added icon that shows when enemies are sundered
[*] Charged shots now behave more consistently with other upgrades and get affected by rate of fire boosts
[*] Updated how ricochet shots are calculated, which should improve damage consistency and losing bufffs
[*] Added new popup that appears during gameplay when a milestone is unlocked
[/list]


[h2]
Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where enemy trails dissapear when enemy dies
[*] Fixed issue where you could stop coop mid run and break some game systems
[*] Fixed issue where chainers still applied slow even though they aren't attached
[*] Fixed issue where Mortar could get stuck while using controller
[*] Fixed issue where projectiles would get destroyed when they go out of screen
[*] Fixed machine learning upgrade for autocannon not increasing damage
[*] Fixed World 2 Boss laser attack not showing
[*] Fixed minor art issues with World 2 Boss
[*] Fixed issue where players would get slowed down while moving in the train
[*] Fixed issue where World 1 Boss missiles were bugged
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2 - Co-Op, Event Location, Coal Overfilling
notes.content: [h1]Welcome to Apocalypse Express 0.2![/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ncx_jRveZhE"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Balance/Additions[/h2][list][*][p]Local Coop - Game is now fully playable with 2 players, difficulty is slightly adjusted to compensate for the additional help. To start coop just use the start coop button from the Pause Menu. Coop is also fully playable using Steam Remote Play![/p][/*][*][p]Event Locations - Experience new locations which give you new ways to earn enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Overfilling System - Unlock a new meta progression upgrade in the HUB that allows you to overfill your furnace with coal boosting your speed. But be careful after you enter overfill you can't let that coal drop, or your furnace is going to go BOOM.[/p][/*][*][p]Small Health System Rework - Train HULL is now tied to how many modules you have, so the more wagons you have the more potential hull you'll have. Also the way you take permanent damage has been changed making it more understandable and easier to manage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added various new sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Updated color picker to be a predefined selection of colors (don't worry free color picking will come back, together will full train customization)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller support - You are now able to interact with all elements and menus in the game with the controller[/p][/*][*][p]Added PlayStation controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements to new unlocks during end of run screen[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy wave that contained 5 Rocket Buses to 4[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle roof of modules when you are not inside them[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where player would get stuck on black screen after killing a Boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Large FPS drop that happened when enemy chains and hoses get destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where you would hit obstacle even though you perform a turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Centipede Drones didn't die after boss death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where World 2 boss could get stuck after getting EMPd[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that didn't allow for the Get 200 Upgrades Milestone to be completed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where heal particles would appear when you spawn if you have the HULL radar upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where decimals would show for damage numbers even though you don't have decimal damage[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed issue where inventory tooltip would get stuck (also fixed the 1 pixel offset it had)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed speed dial showing wrong train speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed chat boxes for bottom 2 NPCs in the HUB[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues introduced with this version[/h3][list][*][p]Using mortar on controller tends to snap to front of train[/p][/*][*][p]If you start coop and stop coop afterwards you will no longer be able to start it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you are interested in joining the apocalypse express community hop on over to our [url="https://discord.gg/5H8Vnacakz"]discord[/url]![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Apocalypse Express has released into Early Access
notes.content:
[p]After years of hard work we are so proud that Apocalypse Express has finally reached Early Access! 

[/p][p]Here is what to expect from the Early Access Version:[/p][list][*][p]World 2, fight through a dozen of new enemies each with unique abilities and attacks, defeat the brand new Metropolis Boss!,[/p][/*][*][p]Notice Board - Complete Milestones as you play the game and unlock new modules and upgrades to create various new builds!,[/p][/*][*][p]Radar - Earn Cores by defeating bosses and spend them on meta progression upgrades that give you an edge on your Journey,[/p][/*][*][p]Tarot Reader - When you beat the game, you unlock harder difficulties, challenge yourself to reach the highest!,[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of new upgrades that allow for some crazy new synergies,[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced enemies in world 1,[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced most upgrades to make them more fair and fun[/p][/*][/list][p]
Though this is just the start! We plan on releasing a roadmap in the coming weeks with a showcase of everything that is planned, and how we plan on reaching 1.0 Full release. There are many cool things in development and we can't wait to share them with you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hop on! Enjoy the ride![/p]

notes.title: Apocalypse Express is a challenging train-combat management roguelike with a demo you need to try
notes.content:
Fogpiercer isn't the only upcoming train combat game around, with Apocalypse Express getting a demo now too but they're both wildly different and worth trying. Apocalypse Express is just chaos and I want more.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/apocalypse-express-is-a-challenging-train-combat-management-roguelike-with-a-demo-you-need-to-try/

notes.title: Apocalypse Express DEMO out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

We are finally ready to share our game with the world!

https://youtu.be/3gtMTCfhU2s


Here are some of the things you can except in the Early Access release:
[list]
[*] First Biome
[*] Dozen modules to acquire and upgrade
[*] Hundreds of upgrades for your modules
[*] Various enemies to encounter and fight
[/list]

Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelite in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting.
Imagine FTL and Overcooked had a baby in a Mad Max world.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223160/Apocalypse_Express/
